11 ([[Tower Outskirts]]) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]3,000 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ent''' was an [[enemy]] that appeared in the second and third night of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It was a stronger version of the [[Overgrowth (Solar Eclipse)|Overgrowth]], having much higher health and a slightly slow speed. ==Appearance== The '''Ent''' was a large humanoid tree. Its body was made out of brown and light brown wood. It had vines covering its body, with a bark crown and carved legs. It had neon light green eyes and brown wooden horns. It walked with a slightly hunched back. ==Strategy== *Use high DPS towers, such as the [[Swarmer]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] to defeat this. **You can use the [[Commander]] to boost your tower's firerate, making them deal more damage. *For its debut, multiple Level 3 [[Crook Boss]]es can handle the '''Ent''' well. *Because this enemy walks quite quickly and has a large amount of health, it is recommended to use the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Sledger]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow this down. **If not taken care of, this enemy will help other enemies overrun your defenses. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Ent''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Ent''' was based on the [[w:c:lotr:Ent|Ent]] from ''The Lord of the Rings''. ==Update History== *'''6 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]b **'''Ent''' added. *'''8 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]d **Now appears in the [[Tower Outskirts]]. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Ent''' removed. {{FoggyForest|[[Wraith]]|Wave 7|Ent|Wave 9|[[Werewolf (Solar Eclipse)|Werewolf]]|Wave 11}} {{TowerOutskirts|[[Wraith]]|Wave 10|Ent & [[Zombie Horse]]|Wave 11|[[Ghost Knight]]|Wave 12}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
